title: MUSE: Multi-Level Memory with Selective Runtime Injection for Scientific Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Historical experience can guide scientific coding at multiple levels, but task-level retrieval may miss implementation lessons that become relevant during execution. We introduce MUSE, a memory management framework combining multi-level memory with selective runtime injection for scientific coding agents. MUSE builds global, approach-level, and implementation-level memory from historical trajectories. At initialization, the agent receives global memory and problem-matched approach-level memory. During execution, current interactions are used to retrieve implementation-level memory. An LLM gate selects relevant experience and generates specific review advice, or skips injection. Across four benchmarks spanning numerical problem solving, kernel optimization, and scientific software repair, MUSE outperforms retrieval and memory baselines on all evaluation metrics. translated_title: MUSE：面向科学编码智能体的多层记忆与选择性运行时注入
translated_abstract: 历史经验可以在多个层面指导科学编码，但任务级检索可能会遗漏那些在执行过程中才变得相关的实现层面的经验教训。我们提出了MUSE，一个面向科学编码智能体、将多层记忆与选择性运行时注入相结合的记忆管理框架。MUSE从历史轨迹中构建全局、方法层面和实现层面的记忆。在初始化时，智能体接收全局记忆以及与问题匹配的方法层面记忆；在执行过程中，利用当前交互来检索实现层面的记忆；一个LLM门控会选择相关经验并生成具体的审查建议，或者跳过注入。在涵盖数值问题求解、内核优化和科学软件修复的四个基准测试中，MUSE在所有评估指标上都优于检索和记忆基线。消融实验验证了多层设计和门控注入的有效性，同时迁移实验……（摘要截断）
tldr: MUSE提出了一种将全局、方法、实现三个层级的记忆与LLM门控选择性运行时注入相结合的记忆管理框架，显著提升了科学编码智能体在数值求解、内核优化和软件修复等任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: MUSE is a memory management framework that combines multi-level memory (global, approach-level, and implementation-level) with selective LLM-gated runtime injection, significantly improving scientific coding agents across numerical problem solving, kernel optimization, and scientific software repair benchmarks.
